title: These Official ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Water Bottles Help You Seal the Honmoon While Quenching Your Thirst
summary: These water bottles are extremely afforable and cute to boot.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The thirst for KPop Demon Hunters isn’t going away anytime soon.

First released on Netflix last June, the film has won over audiences with its poppy, colorful visuals, loveable characters, and memorable chart-topping songs .

The anthem-esque track “Golden” had a run of eight weeks at No. 1 on the multimetric Billboard Hot 100 , from mid-August through mid-October; 18 weeks atop the Billboard Global 200; and a record 20 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart. Most impressive, the song is up for Song of the Year, Best Pop Duo/Group Performance and Best Song Written for Visual Media at the 2026 Grammys , not a small feat given the film has only been out for a little under eight months.

Shoppers and retailers alike have also hopped aboard the Hunters train, with everything from official books to apparel and merch arriving online on the heels of the film’s success. Now, fans of HUNTR/X and the ever charismatic Saja Boys , can pick up these official Kpop Demon Hunters water bottles, with styles for all ages and funky colorways and unique features.

Some of these water bottles are insulated, keeping cool drinks cold and hot drinks toasty, while some feature spill-proof lids and sippable straws. Some are plastic, while others are made from stainless steel .

Every model is washable, either by hand or by popping it in a dishwasher. If the snazzy features weren’t enough, every model has eye-catching graphics on the front that feature the film’s fan-favorite characters. Beyond being extremely cute, these bottles will also hopefully keep you sufficiently hydrated while you or your loved ones fight to seal the Honmoon (or y’know, while you’re traveling, at work or on a run).

Below, you’ll find our KPop Demon Hunters water bottle picks to shop on Amazon. All are officially licensed except for one seen at the end of the list. 

KPop Demon Hunters Officially Licensed HUNTR/X Water Bottle

$26.99

Buy Now On Amazon

This water bottle features the members of HUNTR/X on the front displayed on a purple backdrop. It’s 25 oz. in size and has a leakproof lid. This one isn’t insulated so it’s best for beverages you want to sip now or on-the-go.

KPop Demon Hunters 30oz Tumbler With Straw and Handle

$38.99 $45.99 15% off

This 30 oz. tumbler also features the girls of HUNTR/X on the front. The tumbler comes equipped with a straw for easy drinking and a handle for easy carrying. The tumber promises to keep your drinks cold for 12 hours and hot for up to five hours. It’s presented in a super giftable box too.

KPop Demon Hunters Derpy Officially Licensed Stainless Steel Insulated Tumbler

$28.99

This tumbler is made from stainless steel and features Derpy, a character from KPop Demon Hunters , on the front. The tumbler is insulated, keeping your beverages at their desired temperature for long periods.

KPop Demon Hunters HUNTR/X Officially Licensed Stainless Steel Insulated Tumbler

This tumbler comes in white, with the HUNTR/X girls colorfully depicted in dynamic poses on this lidded sipper. One reviewers say the insulated tumbler kept her tea hot for almost three hours: “I’ve never had [a tumbler] be that hot that many hours later with the lid open,” she writes.

KPop Demon Hunters Saja Boys Heartthrob Officially Licensed Stainless Steel Insulated Tumbler

If you’re more of a fan of the Saja Boys, then this tumbler is for you. The water bottle is black with the boys striking dynamic poses in neon hues. Like the others, insulation proves effective for keeping beverages at correct temperatures for longer periods — in fact, one reviewer says her ice lasted overnight in the bottle.

KPop Demon Hunters Silicone Straw Toppers (10-Pack)

$9.99

This is fan-made merch but cute enough to pick up. This set gets you ten KPop Demon Hunters silicone straw toppers. The product affixes to the straw on your favorite water bottle or tumbler brand of choice, keeping it sealed and secured.

In addition to the Grammys, KPop Demon Hunters is also receiving acclaim from the film industry. At the 2026 Golden Globes , the film won Best Motion Picture – Animated, and Best Original Song – Motion Picture with a win for, you guessed it, “Golden.” At the 2026 Critics Choice Awards, the film took home Best Song for “Golden” and a win for Animated Feature Film. Could an Oscar nod be next?
